author: Kushal
problem: Read a string S of exactly three lowercase letters and print how many different strings can be made by rearranging its letters.
bug_description: The pair check is a separate if instead of elif, so when all three letters are equal the program prints 1 and then also 3.

comments.accurate: Prints how many distinct strings can be formed by rearranging the three letters of S
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints 1 when all three letters match, then reports 3 or 6 from the pairwise letter check
comments.wrong_location: Letter comparisons verified; check that input() keeps a trailing newline out of S
